titulo: Tax Protection with Insider Expertise of a Former SUNAT Officer
parrafo_1: I founded my firm with a clear purpose: to protect your peace of mind and finances against complex tax regulations. I know how stressful it is to receive a notification or worry about tax compliance.
parrafo_2: I worked inside SUNAT as a tax advisor specialized in 4th and 5th category personal taxes. I know the audit criteria, bank cross-checks, and how to resolve issues before they become fines.
